title: Knowing When the Evidence Is Enough: Requirement-Directed Search with Horn-Closure Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2610.34684v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: After each Web search, a search-augmented model must decide whether its evidence suffices: answer, search again, or abstain. Prevailing systems leave this to holistic model judgement, which can accept a context naming every entity yet lacking one required fact. We instead make sufficiency structural: a per-query requirement hypergraph states which facts jointly yield another fact. This raises two challenges: deriving requirements from the question alone, and linking each requirement to passages about the right entity. Certify therefore decomposes the question, searches per requirement, and accepts links only after entity checks. Horn closure over the links yields a certificate, the minimal sufficient passages and their derivation, or an abstention naming open requirements. Given correct retrieval, requirements and links, the decision is sound, and complete up to the entity check. Pooled over three corpora with unanswerable twins, Certi

translated_title: 知道证据何时足够：基于Horn闭包证书的需求导向搜索
translated_abstract: 每次网页搜索之后，搜索增强的模型必须判断其证据是否充分：回答问题、再次搜索，或放弃回答。现有系统将这一判断交给模型的整体性直觉判断，这可能导致模型接受一个虽然提及了所有相关实体、却缺少某个所需事实的上下文。我们转而将“充分性”结构化：针对每个查询构建需求超图，用以声明哪些事实可以共同推导出另一个事实。这带来了两个挑战：仅凭问题本身推导出这些需求，以及将每条需求链接到关于正确实体的文本段落。为此，Certify 对问题进行分解，按需求逐项搜索，并且只有在通过实体检查之后才接受链接。对这些链接进行Horn闭包运算即可产生一个证书——即最小充分段落集及其推导过程；若无法满足，则放弃回答并明确指出尚未满足的需求。在检索、需求和链接均正确的前提下，该决策是可靠的，且在实体检查的范围内是完备的。在包含不可回答孪生问题的三个语料库上的汇总结果显示，Certi（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Certify框架，通过将查询分解为需求超图并利用Horn闭包运算生成证书，把搜索增强模型“证据是否足够”的判断结构化，从而可靠地决定回答、继续搜索或放弃回答并指出缺失的需求。
en_tdlr: Certify makes sufficiency judgments structural for search-augmented models by decomposing queries into requirement hypergraphs and using Horn-closure certificates, enabling sound decisions to answer, search again, or abstain while naming open requirements.
